description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useAttendance' that manages attendance-related state and actions such as clocking in/out, fetching today's status, and attendance history. It interacts with external services and components to facilitate attendance tracking in a frontend application.

methods.name: useAttendance({ userId = 'u-2' } = {})
methods.description: Main hook that encapsulates attendance state and actions for the current user.

methods.name: refreshToday
methods.description: Fetches the current day's attendance status.

methods.name: refreshHistory
methods.description: Fetches attendance history based on current pagination and date filters.

methods.name: onClockIn
methods.description: Handles clock-in action, updates state and fetches latest data.
